audit_scope: LASI Wave 1 Individual extract combined audit (Maharashtra + Daman & Diu)

model_2_cvd_composite.definition: Any of HT002 (hypertension), HT006 (heart disease), or HT007 (stroke) reported as 1=Yes; 2=No across all three for negative

ht006_chronic_heart_disease_alone.notice: Chronic heart disease alone is reported in 209 cases across both states. Model 2 is broad CVD composite, not CAD-specific.

survey_weighting_methodology.methodology_note: LASI is a multi-stage stratified cluster sample. In the combined sample, Maharashtra's state weights reflect ~25.9M adults (mean weight ~6,520) while Daman & Diu reflect ~34,000 adults (mean weight ~34). India individual weights reflect national expansion. Primary reported metrics are unweighted exploratory results from an 80/20 stratified split. Exploratory survey-weighted test metrics are computed using normalized indiaindividualweight (mean=1.0) with scikit-learn sample_weight. Note that scikit-learn sample weights adjust the empirical distribution but do not implement Taylor series linearization or survey cluster/strata variance estimation.

limitations: LASI outcomes are self-reported diagnoses, not prospective incidence or lab-confirmed outcomes.
Baseline models only: no fine-tuning or hyperparameter search was conducted in this experiment.
Primary metrics are unweighted 80/20 stratified split hold-out metrics; complex survey design standard errors require specialized survey software.
Model 1 classifies self-reported diabetes diagnosis; it is not a prospective diabetes risk score.
Model 2 classifies self-reported CVD composite; it is not CAD-specific and not a 10-year Framingham/ASCVD risk score.
Not clinically validated. Do not deploy for clinical decision-making, individual triage, or diagnosis.
Restricted LASI raw respondent data and individual identifiers are not included in this audit or public repository.
